svg.title: The eye at the hole: Fisheye gouache
svg.desc: The eye at the hole (2D): the player's eye at a door viewer fitted backwards. A guest's room is painted in warm opaque gouache inside one curved circle; everything else is the dark door. The guest has set a case down beside the lamp, and the view is held still on it: the amber ring around the lens is three-quarters closed, about to catch the beat as a clue card.
